parameters.help_en: The subscription source. Valid values: OSS, MC, and MSC_EMAIL
parameters.name: report_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
consumeDetailBillV2: consumption details. Supported only for OSS and MC subscriptions.
splitDetailBillV2: split details. Supported only for OSS and MC subscriptions.
costDetailBillV2: cost details. Supported only for OSS and MC subscriptions.
monthBillOverview: monthly bill overview. Supported only for OSS and MSC_EMAIL subscriptions.
focus: focus bills. Supported only for OSS and MC subscriptions
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值类型：
consumeDetailBillV2：消费明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
splitDetailBillV2：分拆明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
costDetailBillV2：成本明细（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）。
monthBillOverview：月账单汇总（仅OSS/MSC_EMAIL订阅支持）。
focus：focus账单（仅OSS/MC订阅支持）
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.help_en: The start billing cycle for data push. After the subscription is created, the system automatically pushes data from the start billing cycle to the current time. This parameter is invalid for monthly billing PDF subscriptions, and historical data is not pushed again. Data within the most recent year can be pushed
parameters.help_zh: 推送起始账期。订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。月账单PDF订阅时此参数无效，不会对历史数据重新推送。最多可推送最近1年内数据
parameters.name: begin_billing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The UID of the OSS owner that stores the files. Specify this parameter if the subscription is made by a bidder or reseller and the files need to be pushed to the OSS bucket of a RAM user. The RAM user must be a subordinate account of the calling account and must be granted the AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole permission. Regular users do not need to specify this parameter. The default value is the calling account
parameters.help_zh: 存储文件的Oss Owner对应的UID。如果是Bid/ReSeller订阅，并需要推送到子账号的OSS上时指定，需要此账号为调用账号子账号，并对此账号授予AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole权限。 普通用户则无需指定，默认为调用账号
parameters.name: oss_bucket_owner_account_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket that stores the files
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The storage path in the OSS bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket_path

parameters.help_en: The name of the MC project
parameters.name: mc_project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MC subscription table
parameters.name: mc_table_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the level-1 site. If this parameter is left empty, the ID of the site to which the current user belongs is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 一级售卖场ID，如果为空，默认使用当前用户所属的场ID填充
parameters.name: nbid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to split attachments by user ID for email subscriptions
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，按userId拆分附件
parameters.name: split_file_on_user_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip sending emails when no bills are generated for email subscriptions
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，无账单时不发送邮件
parameters.name: not_send_on_no_data

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include bill attachments in emails for email subscriptions
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，邮件携带账单附件
parameters.name: send_with_attach

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include enterprise multi-account members in bills for email subscriptions
parameters.help_zh: 邮件订阅相关配置，账单包含企业多账号成员
parameters.name: include_members

parameters.help_en: The fields to which the user subscribes
parameters.name: selected_fields
